decisions.reason: BASE’s “hospital visits” is anachronistic for 병문안; SOL drops 에도 (“even”).
decisions.replacement: Even visiting the sick had a proper order.

decisions.reason: “Hundred-plus” is tighter for 백여 명; “him” is a clear back-reference to Tang Sadok.
Spoken English for 들어간 지 꽤 됐다 without the calqued “it’s been quite a while since they went in.”
“Slipped into” matches 끼어들어서; “joined” is too neutral.
The following line is the answer; dropping 대답했다 avoids redundant attribution.
보고 싶다 is “wanted to see him,” not “visit.”
도대체 is the intensifier BASE flattens to a plain “what.”
“Even communicate” carries 하다 하다 …까지; naming Mimi is already established.
“On your forehead” repeats the prior line; the scar check still lands.
그런 게 있다 means such a thing exists; BASE’s “Never mind” is a mistranslation.
덜컥 on a tightly shut door is a heavy latch sound; “Clunk” fits better than “Clack.”
“Tightly shut” is the natural collocation for 굳게 닫혀 있던.
The Tang Horyong relative clause is smoother; 직계 as “direct descendants” holds.
Looked, then walked: sequential verbs without the “After looking” stack.
SOL replaces 얼마나 걸었을까 and 얼굴들; BASE’s physician clause is stiff.
decisions.replacement: Who knew how long we walked through the pervasive smell of medicinal decoctions? At last, a physician with his nose and mouth covered by white cloth led us into a treatment room, where we came face-to-face with several familiar faces.

decisions.reason: Dialogue is a single 쿨럭, not a doubled cough.
Both drop 힘겹게 잔기침을 내뱉는; SOL’s glance-line still needs that cough.
decisions.replacement: One glance was enough to tell that Tang Sadok, laboring through a faint cough, was in serious condition.

decisions.reason: Limbs/qi is its own Korean sentence once the condition line is split out.
Sickbed 상반신을 일으키다 is “sit up”; reciprocal 눈인사 is “nods.”
Drops the “the reason… was because” calque without losing the confession.
SOL drops 비스듬히; BASE’s “at an angle” is calqued.
decisions.replacement: I crossed my arms at a slant.

decisions.reason: 왜요 is Taekyung’s “Why?” to the blank look, not “What?”
BASE over-specifies 왜요; SOL’s “stared” is not 당황한 얼굴로 물었다.
SOL drops 곰곰이 (“carefully”) from the later thinking-through.
“Its location” is a clean back-reference right after the ring is named.
단단한 against 가벼운 is “solid,” not merely “sturdy.”
Spoken word order for 알려 주면…보존해 주겠다; 가문 as “our family.”
Avoids BASE’s repeated “committed”; 해서는 안 될 일을 저질렀지 still lands.
Keeps survival as heaven’s purpose (사죄하고 벌을 받으라는 뜻), which BASE splits away.
BASE’s “owner of the voice” is calqued; SOL drops 불쑥 들려온.
decisions.replacement: The cold voice that suddenly rang out belonged to Jin Wikyung, who had been listening in silence.

decisions.reason: He is the older brother of those two, so “the,” not “an.”
깊게 가라앉은 is “deeply sunken,” not merely “darkened.”
“Who walks the righteous path” reads as native moral diction for 정도를 걷는 이.
한다면…어쩌시겠습니까 is hypothetical; “would/told” matches.
놀란 눈빛으로 바라봤다 is surprise, not “stared in shock.”
SOL drops 표정; BASE’s “opened his mouth with an expression of” is translationese.
decisions.replacement: With an utterly calm expression, he spoke.

decisions.reason: Restores benefactive 싸워 준 (“for us”) and 명맥 (“family line”); drops “thanks to the fact that.”
복잡한 눈빛 is a look, not “emotions.”
쫀득해지는 is a taut, chewy tightness; SOL’s “clench” genericizes it.
Avoids “the life… was the life”; 달린 as hanging from the other end.
보소 wants “would you look at”; 갑자기 is “suddenly,” not “fast.”
decisions.replacement: *Would you look at how suddenly the mood turned cold.*

decisions.reason: Restores 인의 in 인의대협; “could laugh off” is more idiomatic for 허허 웃고 넘어갈.
이니까 is the explanatory “After all” SOL cuts.
“Take it that far” is the natural English for 그렇게까지.
그래 is self-affirmation (“That was right”), not causal “Because.”
Keeps source order: outsiders weighed against blood relatives.
그전에 빚도 as “Besides, I owed him,” not the calqued “had a debt.”
모종의 is “some sort of”; 신물 here is the family’s sacred artifact.
SOL drops the 퉁 치죠 beat; 쌤쌤 then write-off then walk-back is the joke.
“When I finished” is enough for 내 말이 끝나자.
Cheongpung uses 은인 as a name, so bare “Benefactor,” not “the Benefactor.”
SOL drops contrastive 다만; BASE is stiffer and misses “his household.”
decisions.replacement: “I have already forgotten the matter. But if I have one wish as a physician, it is that the Family Head recover as soon as possible. After all, there are still surviving members of his household.”

decisions.reason: Cuts the calqued “no anger to be felt from him.”
Pronoun after the prior naming avoids repeating Jin Wikyung.
눈동자가 떨렸다 collocates as “trembled,” not “shook.”
입술 사이로 흘러나왔다 is “slipped between his lips,” not generic “emerged.”
은혜를 입다 is to owe a debt of gratitude; 그대들에게 is plural “all of you.”
“Instant… genuine sincerity” and SOL’s “moment… heartfelt” are equal; keep BASE.
사죄 is Apology not Atonement; source UI is Lv.115; keep the 바로 용서입니다 beat; 호의 stays “kindness.”
decisions.replacement:
> **System**
>
> Confessing one’s sins is difficult, but there is something that requires even greater courage. That is forgiveness.
>
> **Hidden Quest:** **Apology and Forgiveness** successfully completed!
>
> **Lv. 115 Tang Sadok** expresses his deep gratitude for your kindness. He and the **Sichuan Tang Clan** will never forget the kindness and assistance you showed them today, and the people of the **Sichuan Tang Clan** will remember you as their **Benefactor**!
>
> **Title Acquired:** **Benefactor of the Tang Clan**
>
> You have gained a tremendous amount of EXP and Fame as a reward for completing the Hidden Quest!
>
> **Level Up!**

decisions.reason: 갑자기 is “all of a sudden,” not “out of nowhere.”
SOL drops 울려 퍼진 (“rung out”) from the System alert.
취릭/취리리릭 need the ㄹ; BASE is a generic hiss, SOL misses 리리.
잠시 깜빡 is “momentarily,” not “temporarily.”
SOL drops 다행히 (“thankfully”).
“Cut in before I could finish” is tighter for 말을 끝맺기도 전에…입을 연.
SOL drops 계속; the line is “continue to keep it.”
“Our family’s sacred artifact” is the natural rendering of 본가의 신물.
Curly apostrophe in “owner’s” is the required typography; content is unchanged.
오늘 무슨 날이야 is “what kind of day is this,” not generic “what was going on.”
Keeps 개 같은 일들 (plural) and 불안하기까지 할 지경; SOL weakens both.
Register matches 하시구려; “speak up” is too brusque, “limits of abilities” is wordy.
The next line is his reply; 대답했다 is implied.
Echoes Sadok’s 원하는 as “desire” in the same elevated register.
SOL drops 과연 (“certainly”).
손발을 배배 꼬며 is bashful squirming; “fidgeting with hands and feet” is a body-part calque.
Uses the required ellipsis character instead of doubled …….
눈이나 떼고 얘기해 is two commands: look away and talk, not “when you’re talking.”
“His own face” is the mirror joke; “brimmed” is stronger than “filled.”
뱀 가죽 is the snake’s hide, not the material “snakeskin.”
희로애락 is joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure; BASE collapses it to joys and sorrows.
만들지 않았다네 is “I never made any”; SOL’s “chose not to” adds motive.
Urgent physician speech: “You’re breathing too quickly” over the clinical “breathing is too rapid.”
BASE drops 청풍을 바라보며; SOL drops 잠시 후.
decisions.replacement: A little while later, after narrowly escaping a hypertensive crisis, Tang Sadok looked at Cheongpung and spoke again.

decisions.reason: Tighter for 아직 맡기겠다고 하지 않았는데 without extra “even.”
저런 is “that,” 틀림없었다 is “undoubtedly”; SOL’s “should/this/clearly” drift.
향후 is “from here on,” not “from here.”
“The last part” is punchier spoken English for 마지막에 했던 말.
Eliding “hear that” after the prior line keeps the bet line sharp.
“Beside himself with joy” is the English idiom for 기뻐서 어쩔 줄을 몰라 했다.
Restores 본래 (“by nature”) in 성정이 까다롭고.
취리리릭 is ri-ri-rik; SOL’s extra r’s smear the syllables.
오메, 시벌 at the trick is startled swearing, not exasperated “for fuck’s sake.”
써 버리네 is the audacity of “busted out,” not plain “using.”
SOL drops 생전 and 얼빠진 목소리; BASE’s “out of his mind” overshoots 넋이 나가.
decisions.replacement: Jin Wikyung, half stunned by the sight he was seeing for the first time in his life, muttered in a dazed voice.

decisions.reason: The comic 지진 still reads, and “shook” is the natural English verb.
한 사람이 추가되었다 is the comic headcount; “joined us” flattens it.
꼭 부탁하고 싶은 is a strong request, not BASE’s mild “would like” or SOL’s “must.”
decisions.replacement: “There is something I very much wish to ask of you before you leave.”
